lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule throughout 2018 in Mali. Geographic boundaries and IPC phase classifications were compiled into spatial datasets (GeoJSON and KML formats) representing food insecurity conditions at different time periods (February, June, December 2018). The IPC classification serves as a post-event or current-situation impact assessment of food insecurity linked to underlying hazards such as drought.
